summary: Full backend + frontend regression of the new 'ship a release' feature on Upcoming Features. Added 6 pytest regressions in tests/test_upcoming_releases_ship.py covering version/released/type persistence, released=true auto-completing all features, PUT flip released true<->false preserving data, and public GET ordering (unreleased soonest-first, then released newest-first). All 6 new tests + 12 existing test_upcoming_features.py tests pass (18/18). Frontend admin editor at /admin/upcoming-features exposes testIDs upcoming-version, upcoming-released-toggle, upcoming-feature-type-0, upcoming-add-feature, upcoming-title, upcoming-save, upcoming-date, upcoming-add and works end-to-end: created release v9.8.7 with released=on and a BUG FIX feature, saw it persist in the admin list with status 'Completed'. Public /upcoming-features screen renders the green 'Available in v9.8.7' banner with correct counts ('0 new features · 1 bug fix · Built on v9.8.7') AND the update hint ('Update available — you're on v3.1.5. Update to get these.') comparing installed APP_VERSION (3.1.5) to release version. Test data cleaned up. No React Native / Expo deprecated packages introduced by this feature. Note: expo.err.log shows pre-existing 'shadow*/textShadow*' style deprecation warnings and expo-notifications web listener warnings — unrelated to this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_upcoming.py PUT: when released is toggled False, previously auto-completed feature statuses remain 'Completed' (they are not restored). This is the documented behavior per user-choice B, but worth noting for admins editing history.

Admin editor cycleStatus() still lets admins set a status locally; when released=true the server correctly overrides to 'Completed', so the pill in the editor may briefly show a non-Completed status until re-fetch.
seed_data_creation: Test releases (TEST_UI_ship v9.8.7) created via UI and cleaned up via DELETE /api/admin/upcoming-features/{id}. All pytest-created TEST_* releases are cleaned up by the test_zz_cleanup fixture in the new test file.
